In Week 8 of STAT 541, we learned about webscraping specific data from websites, primarily by identifying CSS selectors of desired aspects we'd like to scrape.
This is the second and final collaborative lab during our course. After checking <https://www.cheese.com/robots.txt>, we web-scraped
various cheese data from <https://www.cheese.com>, including cheese names, types, and descriptions.
